name: hatod
description: Hatod: local delivery gateway PWA for small towns

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emu,web,sweep -c blue,green,gray "npm run emulators" "npm run dev -w @hatod/web" "npm run sweep:dev"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @hatod/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-hatod --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.emulators:fresh: npm run build -w @hatod/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-hatod
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hatod/functions && npm run build -w @hatod/web
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build -w @hatod/functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hatod --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w @hatod/functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hatod --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "playwright test --trace off"
